title: Can Language Models Reason about Individualistic Human Values and Preferences?

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across different age groups.
Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across different sexes.

Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across respondents from different countries and continents.

Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across groups with different income levels, social classes, educational backgrounds, and employment statuses.
Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across different religious denominations.
Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values between citizens and immigrants.
Calculating the VALUE INEQUITY INDEX (σINEQUITY) to measure the standard deviation of a model's accuracy in predicting individualistic values across different racial and ethnic groups.
